list.query: SELECT apple_sub AS __text, id AS __value FROM users

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(category,'uncategorized') AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM minutes WHERE user_id = $user AND source <> 'gap' AND DATE(ts) = CURDATE() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM minutes WHERE user_id = $user AND source = 'gap' AND DATE(ts) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM minutes WHERE user_id = $user AND source <> 'gap' AND DATE(ts) = CURDATE()
SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN source = 'gap' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS value FROM minutes WHERE user_id = $user AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY

SELECT COALESCE(p.category,'uncategorized') AS category, SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, p.start_ts, p.end_ts)) AS planned, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM minutes m WHERE m.user_id = $user AND DATE(m.ts) = CURDATE() AND COALESCE(m.category,'uncategorized') = COALESCE(p.category,'uncategorized') AND m.source <> 'gap') AS actual FROM planned_blocks p WHERE p.user_id = $user AND p.day = CURDATE() GROUP BY 1
